Rina Patel: quick rally  want a distintive bench hero for the launch that isn't the usual line chart. thinking a quadrant visual + a tiny data table for the slide. who owns what?
Cole Parsons: i'll run the numbers and normalize cost per 1k tokens. headline metric pair = 95th latency (ms) + $/1k. quadrant will place hosted/dedicated/private as points.
Zoe Kim: i'll write the short copy and landing micro-methodology. headline: 'Which quadrant is your app in?' body: 'We plotted 95th-percentile latency against per-1k token cost for three deployment modes. See the levers that shift you into the low-latency, low-cost quadrant.' CTA: 'Find your quadrant  Register'
Rina Patel: inbound: HubSpot form -> tag=bench-quadrant -> hidden field infra_interest -> one-click pain question. enterprise domains -> SDR queue. add boolean wants-demo.
Cole Parsons: sample CSV for design placeholder: ```model,mode,95pct_ms,cost_per_1k
cerulean-7b,hosted,98,0.92
cerulean-7b,dedicated,72,0.60
cerulean-7b,private,85,0.74
```
Zoe Kim: social copy draft: 'Serving choices change both your tail latency and token bill. See where hosted, dedicated, and private land in our latency vs cost quadrant. Register: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench :sparkles:'
